explanation: erdosproblems.com/934 records CCJK's conjecture h_3(d) ≤ d³ − d² + d + 2 (= 54 at d = 4). The Lean statement 71 ≤ h_3(4) refutes it, citing Kumar–Mohar–Pragada [KMP26]: the odd graph KG(7,3) (35 vertices, 4-regular, 70 edges) has any two edges at distance < 3. The arithmetic (35·4/2 = 70, so h_3(4) ≥ 71 > 54) is consistent. This post-dates the page's text but is clearly sourced. Faithful.
